strings.(헤카테가 고개를 들어 먼 곳을 응시한다.): (Hecate raises her head and gazes into the distance.)
The garden is clearly visible from here as well. You have done well, Irfan.
I have reopened the garden's gates as you instructed.
Opening them cannot have been easy. Your body may not be able to withstand...
If you are all right, perhaps I should have assigned you a more difficult task.
I would gladly carry out any other command you give me.
strings.이쯤 되면 넌 내게 물어야 할 것이다. 내가 왜 이런 일을 하고 있는지…: By now, you ought to be asking me why I am doing this...
strings.제가 어찌 감히 신께서 하시는 일의 의중을 묻겠습니까? 저는 당신의 사람: How could I dare question a god's intentions? I am yours. I merely do as you command.
Thank you, Irfan. You are indeed different from that child's servant.
strings.다프네도 이미 알고 있겠지. 먼저 내가 정원을 열도록 허락한 것도, 네가: Daphne must already know. That I first gave permission to open the garden, and that you opened it in accordance with my wishes.
...That beast Pandora was deceived by Daphne, whose cleverness verges on cunning.
strings.하긴, 나조차 그 속을 전혀 알 수가 없으니 짐승이 속은 것도 무리는 아: Then again, even I cannot fathom what she is thinking. It is hardly surprising that the beast was fooled...
Lady Hecate, if Daphne troubles you, I shall eliminate...
No. You need only remain in Elysia and pass the time, as you always do.
Understood. I spoke out of turn.
It is all right. The time simply has not come yet.
strings.(헤카테가 공허한 눈빛을 보이며 이르판의 어깨를 두드린다. 그리고 등을: (With a hollow look in her eyes, Hecate pats Irfan's shoulder. Then she turns and slowly walks away.)
Hah... If we wait, the moon will wax and wane on its own...
strings.응? 칼로네, 나 말하는 거야?: Hm? Callone, are you talking about me?
strings.여기 단장 말고 누가 있습니까?: Who else here is the captain?
Callone, why ask when you already know? I am Parmila, captain of the Oscuras mercenaries.
That is not the answer I am looking for.
strings.단장과 함께 프레이오스 이곳저곳을 둘러보고 있는 게 단순한 일이 아닌 걸: I know there is more to our travels around Freios than a simple sightseeing trip.
You're awfully firm today. As unyielding as a rock, Callone...
Sorry, Callone. I wasn't trying to make a fool of you.
Please don't look so helpless... It only makes me feel worse...
And are you certain now? Certain about me...?
Quite certain. You have already become someone I like, Callone.
Don't get the wrong idea. I mean you are one of the people I like.
Understood. I am so used to it now that there is no chance of a misunderstanding.
strings.에이, 시시한데. 어쨌든 내게 일이 생겼어. 당신이 마법청 연구소 일 때: Aw, how dull. Anyway, something came up for me. It started after you joined us because of what happened at the Magic Bureau's research institute...
I need to save you, but because of what happened in the past, I also need to save myself and our boss.
strings.나쁜 귀족가에 입양됐다가 파양됐을 때, 내가 죽을 뻔한 날이 있었어. 그: After a cruel noble family adopted me and then cast me out, there was a day when I nearly died. The boss was the mercenary captain who saved me.
You never mentioned anyone like that.
strings.모두의 기억 속에서 사라진 사람이니까…. 정말이지. 나만 기억한다는 게: Because that person has vanished from everyone's memory... Honestly, it is so unfair that I am the only one who remembers...
strings.두목은 내게 은인 같은 사람이야. 파양됐던 내가 죽을 뻔한 상황에서 구해: The boss is my benefactor. The one who saved me when I was about to die after being cast out... Oh, doesn't 'boss' feel warmer than 'captain'?
strings.어쨌든 두목은 어느 순간 사라졌어. 마법청과 관련된 일을 확인하러 간다더: Anyway, one day the boss disappeared. Said there was something involving the Magic Bureau to investigate, and never came back.
strings.에…, 뭐야, 그 애매한 반응은…? 더 알고 싶은 거 없어?: Uh... What's with that vague reaction...? Isn't there anything else you want to know?
strings.마법청을 조사하는 일 말고 더 알아야 되는 게 있습니까? 마법청 캠프가: Is there something else I need to know besides the investigation into the Magic Bureau? That explains why we came here, where the Bureau has a camp...
strings.마법학원 제레니스에 갔을 때, 내가 시이나와 친구인 걸 보고 당황해 했잖: When we went to Xerenis Magic Academy, you were shocked to see that Shiina and I were friends. Aren't you curious about that?
I thought that was none of my business...
strings.너무하네, 칼로네. 조금 더 궁금해할 거라 생각했는데. 시이나는 내가 파: How cold, Callone. I thought you would be a little more curious. Shiina seems to think it is her fault I was cast out...
strings.사실 내가 파양된 건 다른 사람들이 쉽게 보지 못하는 걸 보고, 쉽게 느: The truth is, they cast me out because I could see things other people could not easily see, and sense things they could not easily sense...
That is also how I found that little kitten who was a witch...
strings.마녀? 그게 무슨 말입니까? 마녀를 찾았다뇨?: A witch? What do you mean? You found a witch?
strings.잠깐, 칼로네. 당신 뒤에 마족이 있어…. 조심해!: Wait, Callone. There is a demon behind you... Look out!
strings.(깜짝 놀란 칼로네가 품 안에서 단검을 꺼내 뒤에 있는 존재를 향해 던진: (Startled, Callone draws a dagger from inside his clothes and throws it at the presence behind him.)
strings.(다행인지 아닌지 칼로네의 단검은 파르밀라가 말했던 마족의 옆을 스치고: (Fortunately, or perhaps unfortunately, Callone's dagger passes just beside the demon Parmila mentioned.)
strings.이, 인터뷰는 허락받고 했어야 하는데, 죄송합니다무! 트, 특종을 찾아야: I-I should have asked permission for an interview! I'm sorry, squawk! I-I came all this way driven by my duty to find a scoop, but I don't want to die!!
strings.살려주세요무! 말하는 앵무새 정도로만 생각해주세요무! 님 말 잘 따라합니: Spare me, squawk! Just think of me as a talking parrot! I'm good at repeating what you say. W-Who else here is the captain, squawk!!
strings.마족이라고 은신도 할 줄 아네? 자, 앵무새 씨. 자기 소개 하면 살려줄: So even a parrot can conceal itself when it is a demon? Now, Mr. Parrot. Introduce yourself, and I'll let you live.
strings.저는 특종을 찾으러 로젠가르텐 밖으로 나왔다가 돌아갈 곳이 없어서 프리랜: I am Daniel, a humble reporter who left Rosengarten in search of a scoop and became a freelancer because I had nowhere to return to!
strings.살려주시는 겁니까무?: Does this mean you'll spare me, squawk?
strings.혹시 마녀과 관련된 기사쓴 적 있어?: Have you ever written an article about witches?
strings.(파르밀라에 질문에 다니엘의 눈이 반짝거린다.): (Daniel's eyes light up at Parmila's question.)
strings.마녀가 마녀를 죽이고, 마녀를 모으고 있다는 아주 따끈따끈한 소식입니담!: I have a piping-hot story about a witch who kills witches and gathers other witches together!!
strings.그리고 실바리아 제국 의회의 아론 의장이 마녀와 손을 잡았다고 합니다무!: And I hear Chairman Aaron of the Silvaria Empire's council has joined forces with a witch, squawk!!
